compactionProfiles.name: hero-1000x227-e1
compactionProfiles.method: Diffusion-only native output. Core width is sqrt of >=250 all-channel pixel area inside source +/-8% image width. Short-ray radius is last >=240 all-channel sample on the leftward horizontal five-pixel mean profile. Warm shoulder/spread radii are last mean RGB on-minus-off >=80/20 byte samples. Output-space metrics include the unchanged physical Sun and tone mapping; ratios are approximate visual footprints, not radiometric radii.
